study: LP-ALLOC (2026-10-10): how much money live-prep should get and how its rule should use it. Live-prep's rule on a five-day full-universe record (10-05 -> 10-09 UTC) built from the pm-rec archive, each minute scored on the reward programme the listing showed then (the reward check, Addendum 9), fills at-price (they reproduced 10-09's live fills) and strict, at total caps $330 / $430 / $580 / $830 / $1,330 over markets a day, order size, the ceiling on N, the market cap, the budget, the side cap, a drift stop, leaving out market types, a reserve that refills vacated places, a steady-programme check at selection, re-selection, and no BUY its formula scores 0; with markouts by market type and of zero-score quotes on RW's, RW-C's and live-prep's paper fills, and the programmes' intraday changes
asked: Davies, 2026-10-10: "如果我现在想补充资金你建议补多少并切策略如何改进，增加QUOTING TODAY的数量吗？你研究一下确保效果最好"; the coordinator's additions the same night (programme changes, refill, CLOB check, R band, adverse selection by type, inventory knobs, concentration, zero-score quotes)

inputs.<pmrec dir> (not committed, 1.7 GB): every pm-rec archive object 2026-10-04 19:00 -> 10-09 23:00 UTC (books, universe, prints, the daily markets dumps), downloaded by ../lpself/scripts/fetch.py from the signed URLs of ../lpself/sql/archive_urls.sql (never written to any file here), each checked against pm_rec_archive.sha256
inputs.data/progs.json.gz: scripts/split_progs.py on the record, gzip'd: each kept market's programme through the window
inputs.data/aux.json: sql/aux.sql (../lpself's statement): every paper record's settlements, live-prep's selections and paper days
inputs.data/lp_orders_live.json.gz: sql/lp_orders_live.sql: live-prep's live orders, taken out of the recorded books
inputs.data/lp_live_1009.json, data/lp_minutes_: sql/lp_live_1009.sql and sql/readout_1009.sql: 10-09's live fills, selections, minutes and what Polymarket paid
inputs.data/live_1009_progs.json: scripts/prog_timeline.py: the ten 10-09 live markets' programmes through the day

run: deno run --v8-flags=--max-old-space-size=12000 --allow-read --allow-write --allow-env --no-check scripts/build.ts <pmrec dir> data/aux.json data/pr_record.json 2026-10-05T00:00:00Z 2026-10-10T00:00:00Z data/lp_orders_live.json.gz 200
python3 -I scripts/split_progs.py data/pr_record.json data/progs.json && gzip -9 data/progs.json

for LB in 0 120; for STAGE in check grid nmax knobs live ideas risk zero (ideas only at 0); for FILL in '' --at-price: LOOKBACK=$LB deno run --v8-flags=--max-old-space-size=7000 --allow-read --allow-write --allow-env --no-check scripts/alloc_run.ts data/pr_record.json data/progs.json.gz $STAGE $FILL; then gzip -9 results/raw/*/*.json
python3 -I scripts/analyse.py 0 > results/analysis_lb0.txt; python3 -I scripts/analyse.py 120 > results/analysis_lb120.txt

python3 -I scripts/calib.py data/lp_minutes_live_1009.json.gz data/live_1009_progs.json data/readout_1009.json > results/calib.txt; python3 -I scripts/calib_sim.py > results/calib_sim.txt; python3 -I scripts/live_fills.py data/pr_record.json > results/live_fills.txt
python3 -I scripts/prog_stats.py data/pr_record.json > results/prog_stats.txt; python3 -I scripts/markouts.py > results/markouts.txt
reproduced: LPSELF_SEED=1 scripts/build.ts over 10-05 -> 10-09 then alloc_run.ts check: L1 reproduces ../lpself/results/lp_pr.json and lp_pr_atprice.json byte for byte (results/seedcheck.txt; that record was not kept, the disk being full)

the stages check, grid, nmax, knobs, live and ideas ran before the options refill, driftStop and zeroBuy and the fields refills and worstMarkets were added (all default off); `live --at-price` run again with the committed code gives every committed value and adds only those fields
notes: alloc_sim.ts is ../lpcap/scripts/cap_sim.ts with options only (liveProg, nearCertain, driftStop, refill, zeroBuy) and counters; with them unset it is cap_sim.ts line for line; the formula and the fill model are RW's own functions (pmrw.ts)

R in the analyses is in the simulator's units: 0.47 is 10-09's live R of 0.81 on the path's own formula (the simulator's formula is 1.72 x the path's on the same markets and minutes, results/calib_sim.txt)
